description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “SPF 30A”, a modern pet-friendly retreat nestled in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Designed for laid-back luxury and effortless group gatherings, this beautifully appointed 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath home comfortably sleeps up to 12 guests. Enjoy a private backyard oasis with a seasonally heated pool and spa, unwind in stylish coastal interiors and take advantage of a prime location just minutes from the white-sand beaches of 30A. Spend your days biking to the beach, exploring Seaside or relaxing poolside before ending the evening with dinner on the patio. “SPF 30A” offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience and relaxed coastal living. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Pet-Friendly: Bring your four-legged friend along for the adventure5 Bedrooms + 5.5 Bathrooms: Sleeps up to 12 in comfort and stylePrivate Seasonally Heated Pool and Spa: Enjoy in-pool loungers and poolside loungers for relaxing in the sunFenced-In Backyard: Spacious patio with gas grill, outdoor dining and an outdoor shower3-Minute Bike Ride to Seagrove Beach: Easy access to sugar-white sands and turquoise waterChef-Style Kitchen: Stainless steel appliances, bar seating and dining for 6Dedicated Office Space: Stay connected with a desk and printer setup7 Bikes Included: Cruise to Seaside, Grayton Beach and beyond*** LIVING AREA ***The first-floor living area is bright, inviting and designed for connection. With comfortable seating, natural light and easy access to the backyard, this space is perfect for unwinding after a day along 30A or gathering for a relaxed evening at home.Comfortable sofas and chairs perfect for group loungingLarge flat-screen TV for movie nights or sportsSeamless flow into the kitchen and dining area for entertaining*** KITCHEN & DINING ***From casual breakfasts to shared dinners, the open-concept kitchen and dining space is fully equipped for everything your group needs. Designed with both function and style in mind, it’s a natural gathering place throughout your stay.Stainless steel appliances and ample counter spaceBar seating for 4 at the island - great for snacks or sipping wineDining table with seating for 6Easy access to outdoor dining and grill setup*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***Step into your private backyard retreat where outdoor living takes center stage. Lounge in the pool, unwind in the spa or gather for meals and conversation in a space designed for both relaxation and entertaining. The fully fenced backyard also creates a secure and comfortable setting for your four-legged guests, making it easy for everyone to enjoy the outdoors together.Private seasonally heated pool and spaIn-pool loungers plus poolside loungers for all-day relaxationFenced-in backyard with gas grill and outdoor dining area, perfect for pets to roam safelyOutdoor shower for easy post-beach rinsesSpacious patio perfect for lounging, cocktails and evening gatherings*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, patio access and En-Suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerHalf Bathroom: Conveniently located off the kitchenLaundry Room: Full-size washer and dryer for easy cleanups2nd Floor:King Guest Suite: King bed, balcony access and En-Suite with single vanity and walk-in showerBunk Room: Twin-over-Full bunk and En-Suite with single vanity and shower/tub comboBunk Room: Twin-over-Full bunk and En-Suite with single vanity and shower/tub comboKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-Suite with single vanity and walk-in showerOffice Nook: Dedicated workstation with desk and printer*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Set in the heart of Seagrove Beach, “SPF 30A” gives you easy access to everything that makes 30A unforgettable - from bike paths and state parks to foodie favorites and vibrant beach towns.3-Minute Bike Ride to Beach Access: Enjoy beach days without the hassleSeaside (1.6 Miles): Explore the charming and vibrant community of Seaside, filled with boutique shops, unique eateries and a laid-back, small-town coastal atmosphere.Nearby Restaurants (0.5-2 Miles): Savor coastal flavors at Café Thirty-A, enjoy the upscale beachy vibe of Surfing Deer or indulge in local seafood favorites at Old Florida Fish House.Grayton Beach State Park (3 Miles): Immerse yourself in nature with scenic trails, serene paddling adventures and breathtaking views of the Gulf - you’ll feel a world away from it all.Bike-friendly streets and access to the 30A Timpoochee Trail*** PET FRIENDLY ***Non shedding, housebroken dogs onlyPets are not allowed on furniture or bedsMust be kept in a crate when guests are not with their dogPets are not allowed in the pool at anytimeWith non-refundable pet fee $250 + tax*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesThe private pool is heated from September 1-April 30Please note that there is active construction next door to this home. We do not have a completion date at this time*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 120014STRO #: STR-222004
